A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the propionibacteria in Leerdammer are P. freudenreicihi, P. jenseii, and 'P. rubrurn' strains.
P. jenseni is the most common propionibacterium in Leerdammer, and the only one isolated from the cheese, which is not in agreement with earlier studies.
the 'classical species' P. acidopropionici, and P. thoeii, are not present in Leerdammer cheeses.

P. acidipronici, P. jenseni and P. freudenreicihii are the main species of propionibacteria in Leerdammer, and that P. thoeni and P. acidipononici are the least abundant.
